Minor typo in `TRUNCATED_RECORD_VALUE`: the setting name uses a backtick for the opening delimiter and a single quote for the closing delimiter:
```java
+ "`xpack.watcher.max.history.record.size' setting";
```
Should be either both backticks (`` `xpack.watcher.max.history.record.size` ``) or both double-quotes for consistency.

After calling `dropLargeFields()` and re-serializing, there is no check that the resulting record actually fits within `maxHistoryRecordSize`. If the large contribution comes from other fields (e.g., `vars`, `watch`, or `triggerEvent`), the record will still exceed the limit and be indexed as-is. Consider either:
- Logging a warning when the truncated record still exceeds the limit, or
- Documenting that this setting only guarantees truncation of `input` and `result` fields, not a hard cap on total document size.

review_comment: I'm also assuming that adding a new field to the history store doesn't need any further changes to mappings or anything?

It looks like `input` doesn't specify dynamic, so it defaults to dynamic (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/template-resources/src/main/resources/watch-history.json#L108). And `result` is explicitly dynamic (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/template-resources/src/main/resources/watch-history.json#L136).
